section.content: 一种包含附加用户逻辑电路的微型计算机，在微型计算机内部测试模式中可独立地对附加用户逻辑电路和微型计算机进行测试。在附加用户逻辑电路和微型计算机之间提供有一个专用连接逻辑电路，其与微型计算机的一条内部总线耦合。为测试附加用户逻辑电路，使用一个读出/写入信号和微型计算机的一个总线/端口转换接头实现读出/写入操作。同时，在专用连接逻辑电路中提供有一个总线检测寄存器。为测试微型计算机，检测寄存器的一个输出被读出至专用连接逻辑电路的一条总线从而进行总线检测。

Micro-computer capable of independently testing an additional logic for user and a pre-existing micro-computer portion in a shipment test of the micro-computer having the enclosed additional logic for user. A logic dedicated to connection is directly coupled to an internal bus of the micro-computer and is provided between the additional logic for user and the micro-computer. For testing the additional logic for user, a bus/port changeover terminal of the micro-computer and a read/write signal are used to effect readout/writing. Also, a bus inspection register is provided in the logic dedicated to connection. For testing the micro-computer, an output of the inspection register is read out to a bus of the logic dedicated to connection to inspect the bus.

SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit)Technical field

The present invention relates to a kind of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) with microcomputer and user logic circuit.More particularly, relate to a kind of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) by bus additional new logical circuit on microcomputer.

Background technology

If in a kind of this type integrated circuit of routine, an existing microcomputer links to each other with an additional logical circuit, then need between an external bus of microcomputer and this accessory logic circuit, to provide a special-purpose logical circuit that connects, microcomputer is connected logical circuit by one bar external bus/port translation joint and links to each other with this special use, and the further user logical circuit is connected logical circuit by its external bus and links to each other with this special use, and the above discloses JP-A-58141 referring to Jap.P..For recovering the port function that microcomputer loses because of above connection, this special use connects logical circuit and has been given the port analog functuion.

Summary of the invention

But above-described routine techniques has following defective:

First inconvenience is that the circuit scale of its chip integral body of integrated circuit of the proposition among the open JP-A-58141 of Jap.P. becomes big, thereby has hindered the reduction of integrated circuit size and cost.

Its reason is, because the special-purpose logical circuit that connects places the outside of the bus/port translation joint of microcomputer as expansion, so port function has been given microcomputer simultaneously and special use is connected logical circuit.

Specifically, the example that has shown a dedicated logic circuit among Fig. 2 of the open JP-A-58141 of Jap.P., a bus/port translation the joint of the computing machine among Fig. 1 of this patent disclosure (3 among this patent disclosure Fig. 1) comprises a switch sections (SW12 and SW13 among this patent disclosure Fig. 2) and a latch (16 among this patent disclosure Fig. 2) simultaneously, thereby has two circuit with identical function in same chip.

Second defective is, in the integrated circuit that in the open JP-A-58141 of above-described Jap.P., proposes, as will all parts in the chip being detected, then need a test pattern that works under the single chip mode, promptly be in by the CPU in the microcomputer and directly control under the state of further user logical circuit.

Its reason is that a part in the chip can not be worked under non-single chip mode.More particularly, the switch (switch 11 of Fig. 2 of the open JP-A-58141 of Jap.P.) that special-purpose of connecting logical circuit is used for connecting microcomputer bus and further user logical circuit bus can't be driven under non-single chip mode, therefore needs the test pattern of a special use.

The 3rd defective is that if the integrated circuit that shows among open JP-A-58141 second embodiment of Jap.P. drives under the accessory logic circuit test pattern, then chip needs a large amount of external lugs.

Its reason is that the interrupt request singal of further user logical circuit output needs the external lug output through chip.

Therefore, an object of the present invention is, the integrated circuit that provides a kind of size and weight to reduce, by the switch or the port signal latch that are used to realize the port analog functuion in the special use connection logical circuit of removing custom integrated circuit, with the simplification circuit, thus the size and the weight of reduction circuit.

Another object of the present invention provides a kind of integrated circuit, wherein, the operational testing (needing a large amount of operation stepss originally with the setup test pattern) that special use is connected logical circuit is simplified, and makes the throughput rate of integrated circuit and the raising of reliability become possibility.

Another object of the present invention provides a kind of integrated circuit, and aforementioned custom integrated circuit external lug number of a chip in test pattern is reduced, and makes the size of integrated circuit and the reduction of weight become possibility.

In order to finish above purpose, a scheme of the present invention provides a kind of integrated circuit that has a microcomputer and a further user logical circuit in a semi-conductor chip, comprise that also a special use that connects microcomputer and user logic circuit is connected logical circuit, wherein microcomputer has a port circuit to link to each other with an external lug.This port circuit can be by external lug from chip exterior input data or to the chip exterior output data, port circuit links to each other with one first bus of microcomputer inside.Special-purpose connect logical circuit and be used to be connected second bus of further user logical circuit and first bus of microcomputer inside links to each other.To the further user logical circuit to read with writing be to realize by the joint that links to each other with the microcomputer port circuit.

In integrated circuit of the present invention, the special use that connects microcomputer and further user logical circuit is connected logical circuit and has a bus detected register, and whether this register is used to detect second bus that is used to connect the further user logical circuit working properly.It is identical with the data transmission width of second bus that the bit wide of bus detected register is made as.The bus detected register is assigned to the address of regulation in order to read or to write data from microcomputer, also can read or write one from microcomputer through first and second buses and select data.

In the integrated circuit based on third party's case of the present invention, the further user logical circuit is to interrupt request singal of microcomputer output.The special use that is used to connect microcomputer and further user logical circuit is connected logical circuit an interrupt request transmission circuit, is used for the interrupt request singal of further user logical circuit output is transferred to microcomputer and an interrupt request singal detected register.The interrupt request singal detected register has a plurality of data bit corresponding with the interrupt request singal number.A selective value is allowed to write from microcomputer each data bit of interrupt request singal detected register.In this integrated circuit, also provide the circuit that an output that is used for replacing each data bit of register of interrupt request singal transfers to microcomputer.

In another program of the present invention, a kind of SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) that has a microcomputer and a further user logical circuit in a semi-conductor chip is provided, and a special use that directly links to each other with an internal bus of microcomputer is connected logical circuit and places between further user logical circuit and the microcomputer.At test period to the further user logical circuit, accessory logic circuit is not subjected to the control of the CPU of microcomputer, bus/port translation joint by using microcomputer and reading/write control signal is connected logical circuit from the outside through aforementioned internal bus and special use the further user logical circuit is read or write operation.Further feature of the present invention is referring to appended claim.

The present invention has following beneficial effect:

First effect of the present invention is that the area of integrated circuit can reduce, thereby has realized the reduction of size and alleviating of quality.

Its reason is that in the present invention, the special-purpose connection in the logical circuit saved the port analog functuion, makes the chip area of integrated circuit reduce.

Second effect of the present invention is to have improved the reliability of integrated circuit.

This is because in the present invention, connecting the bus detected register that provides in the logical circuit in special use can detect the internal bus in the connection microcomputer and the on-off element of the bus in the further user logical circuit.

The 3rd effect of the present invention be, the piece-ups of integrated circuit reduce to have improved its reliability.

This be because, in the present invention, the detection output of the interrupt request singal of further user logical circuit output and the port function of microcomputer use synchronously, with the output of detected register (rather than out splice going splice) interrupt request singal, thereby reduced the quantity of out splice going splice as the input of interruptable controller in microcomputer.The detected register that interrupt request singal also is provided simultaneously is in order to simplify the detection of interruptable controller.
